prompts.name: oxygen-player-v2
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production Unity 2D educational minigame sprite, isolated transparent cutout.
Primary request: a charming red blood cell player character for an oxygen-delivery game. One single mature red blood cell, anatomically recognizable as a soft biconcave disc with a deep central depression, no nucleus. Warm vermilion and coral, glossy soft toy-like 2.5D painted game art, thick clean silhouette, tiny friendly eyes and a small smile low on the rim. Three-quarter top view, full character centered with generous 12 percent transparent margin. Subtle rim highlight, no cast shadow outside the object. Suitable at 80 pixels, bold readable forms and limited fine detail.
Constraints: exactly one cell; no arms, legs, cape, equipment, surrounding objects, letters, logos, watermark, border or UI. Genuinely transparent background with alpha. This is the actual game sprite, not a mockup.

prompts.name: oxygen-vessel-pixel-sketch
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2D Unity arcade arena background texture, opaque, landscape 4:3 composition.
Primary request: an inside-the-bloodstream backdrop in crisp PIXEL ART plus INK SKETCH style. Warm burgundy and dusty coral vessel walls frame the outer 10 percent; a broad uninterrupted dark plum center is reserved for active game sprites. A few subtle curved flow lines and sparse angular pencil hatch marks along the edges suggest circulation. Pixel clusters and stair-step shapes, hand-inked contours, limited muted palette, matte colors. Calm readable low-contrast center; decorative detail only at outer edges. Avoid detailed perspective tunnel that competes with gameplay. No smooth 3D render or glossy lighting. No border outside the vessel texture. Fill entire canvas.
